# KP Fasteners

> Premier industrial fastener manufacturer and supplier based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. In-house OEM production of foundation bolts, stud bolts, sag rods, and structural fasteners with pan-India dispatch.

## Core Capabilities & Infrastructure
- In-house manufacturing at Ghanshyam Industrial Estate, Ahmedabad: cold-sawing, threading, thread-rolling (M8 to M64), and hydraulic bending.
- Primary OEM lines: Foundation & Anchor Bolts (IS 5624, DIN 529, ASTM F1554), Stud Bolts (ASTM A193 B7 / B8 / B8M), Sag Rods, and Scaffold Accessories.
- Distribution lines: High-Tensile Hex Bolts & Nuts (Property Classes 4.6, 8.8, 10.9, 12.9), CSK Allen Bolts, Tie Rods, Solar MMS Fasteners.
- Quality assurance: EN 10204 3.1 Mill Test Certificates (MTC) with heat number batch traceability and chemical analysis.
- Statutory registrations: GSTIN 24ARDPP9803A1Z3, Ministry of MSME Udyam Registration Certificate UDYAM-GJ-01-0118182.

## Product Catalog & Specifications
- [Foundation & Anchor Bolts](https://kpfasteners.com/products/foundation-bolts/): J, L, U, headed, hooked, and swedge foundation bolts to IS 5624, DIN 529, and ASTM F1554 Grade 36/55. Diameters M12 to M72 in mild steel and high-tensile steel with HDG or zinc electroplating.
- [Industrial Stud Bolts](https://kpfasteners.com/products/stud-bolts/): Fully-threaded, tap-end, and double-end studs to ASTM A193 B7, B7M, B8, B8M, and DIN 976 with mating ASTM A194 2H/8M heavy hex nuts. Diameters M8 to M64.
- [Structural Sag Rods](https://kpfasteners.com/products/sag-rods/): Threaded tie and sag rods for Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) bracing, roof purlin support, and solar mounting racking. Property classes 4.6 and 8.8.
- [High-Tensile Fasteners](https://kpfasteners.com/materials/high-tensile-fasteners/): Property classes 4.6, 8.8, 10.9, and 12.9 mechanical properties, UTS, yield strengths, torque charts, and hydrogen embrittlement relief guidelines per ISO 898-1.
- [Stainless Steel Fasteners](https://kpfasteners.com/materials/stainless-steel-fasteners/): Austenitic SS 304 (A2-70) and SS 316 (A4-70 / A4-80) corrosion-resistant fasteners for marine, chemical, solar, and coastal infrastructure.
- [Hex Bolts & Nuts](https://kpfasteners.com/products/hex-bolts-nuts/): Metric and imperial hex head bolts, heavy hex nuts, and washers to DIN 933, DIN 931, ISO 4017, and IS 1363.
- [CSK Allen Bolts](https://kpfasteners.com/products/csk-allen-bolts/): Countersunk socket head cap screws to DIN 7991 and socket screws to DIN 912 across high-tensile and stainless grades.
- [Scaffold Accessories](https://kpfasteners.com/products/scaffold-accessories/): Formwork tie rods, anchor nuts, wing nuts, and water barrier plates.
- [Solar Accessories](https://kpfasteners.com/products/solar-accessories/): MMS module mounting fasteners, solar structure T-head bolts, and mid/end clamps.
- [Custom Engineered Fasteners](https://kpfasteners.com/products/custom-fasteners/): Non-standard fasteners manufactured to project drawings, isometric schedules, and custom BOQs.
- [Engineering Tools & Weight Lookup](https://kpfasteners.com/tools/): Interactive fastener unit weight calculators, thread pitch tables, and metric dimension charts.
